description: The Puckett Cigar Box Guitar channel primarily features instructional lessons and demonstrations for playing 3-string cigar box guitars, focusing heavily on blues techniques, licks, and music theory for beginners and intermediate players. Videos also cover essential topics like chord shapes, slide playing, various tunings (such as GDG and EBE), and song tutorials ranging from traditional hymns to rock covers. Additionally, the channel includes content on building and modifying these instruments, showcasing custom builds and gear tests.
